en.help.title: C# Language Server (csharp-ls)
en.help.message: "csharp-ls" provides completion, diagnostics, hover docs, go-to-definition and refactoring for C#. Install it as a global .NET tool; the language server starts from the language configuration. NuGet packages are restored automatically when a trusted workspace's .csproj/.sln is opened.
